title: Foundation architecture review round 1
summary: Research-only hub collections accepted. Preserve namespace/physical-role/key-pair/ambiguity semantics; resolve canonical pinned metadata into rebuildable DataTug view. Prefer existing browser OVDB federation for the first supported wave; CLI anonymous and multi-server parity are conditional later prerequisites. Canonical catalog-domain allowlist remains blocking. This is architecture review, not semantic reconciliation or selection.
